g.text: Coverage under the same known-cohort median cutoff
All event kinds; both arms use the same fixed known-cohort q50 cutoff within each view/noise/score. Tied ticks stay together.
The square standardizes new within-mode rates to the known mixture. This is descriptive and order dependent; no causal or calibrated-risk claim.
